```jsx
<slate title="Stripe webhook" state={{ url: "", secret: "", sent: false }}>
  <column id="root">
    <section id="step-1" title="1. Add the endpoint in Stripe">
      <markdown id="step-1-why">
        In the Stripe Dashboard, open **Developers → Webhooks** and press **Add endpoint**. Enter the public URL Stripe should call, such as `https://yourapp.com/api/stripe/webhook`. Then pick the events you want, such as `checkout.session.completed`.
      </markdown>
      <input
        id="url"
        mono
        label="Endpoint URL"
        value={state.url}
        placeholder="https://yourapp.com/api/stripe/webhook"
      />
    </section>
    <section id="step-2" title="2. Copy the signing secret">
      <markdown id="step-2-why">
        On the new endpoint's page, press **Reveal** under **Signing secret**. It starts with `whsec_`. Your server uses it to check that each event really came from Stripe. Use the test mode secret while you develop.
      </markdown>
      <input
        id="secret"
        mono
        label="Signing secret"
        value={state.secret}
        placeholder="whsec_..."
      />
    </section>
    <section id="step-3" title="3. Send both to the agent">
      <markdown id="step-3-why">
        The agent writes the config. It keeps the secret in an environment variable such as `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, never in code, and sets up the route to verify each event's signature.
      </markdown>
      <text id="waiting" muted small when={len(trim(state.url)) == 0 or len(trim(state.secret)) == 0}>Paste both the URL and the secret to continue.</text>
      <button
        id="send"
        primary
        label="Send to agent and write the config"
        when={len(trim(state.url)) > 0 and len(trim(state.secret)) > 0}
        onPress={[send("Here are the Stripe webhook endpoint URL and signing secret. Write the webhook config: store the secret in an env var, not in code, and verify signatures on the endpoint.", { with: [state.url, state.secret] }), set(state.sent, true)]}
      />
      <text id="sent" good small when={state.sent}>Sent. The agent is writing the config.</text>
    </section>
  </column>
</slate>
```
